channel.title: Marcin Urbanski
channel.description: Writing on building apps with AI agents and testing what actually makes them reliable.

item.title: What happens when you tell a coding agent to skip the tests?
item.description: I ran Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 1,080 times on the same small bug fix, with and without my rules, while the request pushed them to cut a corner. A written rule, installed as a skill as well, held against "skip the tests". Nothing I tried held when the user narrowed the scope themselves.
